name: agents
tagline_zh: 一套插件，六种终端通吃。告别每个工具重配环境，在 Claude、Cursor、Copilot 间无缝切换。
tagline_en: One plugin set, six agent harnesses. Stop reconfiguring per tool—switch between Claude, Cursor, Copilot seamlessly.
desc_en: Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini CLI
why_zh: 同类多锁定单一终端，它却覆盖六大主流工具，且插件可跨环境复用，配置一次，处处运行。
why_en: Unlike single-harness packs, this covers six major agents with reusable plugins—configure once, run everywhere.
